notes: If you have named your kit, it now uses that name everywhere it refers to itself: your editor's tool hints, the app menu and notifications, and the notes it writes. It no longer falls back to "Kit".
Renaming your kit no longer leaves the old name behind as a broken connection in your coding tools; it updates cleanly wherever you have added it.
When your kit explores or improves on its own, it now points that energy at your work and projects, rather than at its own inner workings.
